settings.apptoken.label: Cider API token
settings.apptoken.description: From Cider → Settings → Connectivity → External Application Access (apptoken header). Leave empty to reuse ~/.config/cider-kde-notifier/config.json.
settings.base_url.label: Cider API URL
settings.display_mode.label: Track alert style
settings.display_mode.description: Noctalia notification (recommended), rich OSD panel, or silent on track changes.
settings.save_to_history.label: Save track alerts to history
settings.save_to_history.description: When using notifications, also keep them in notification history. Off by default.
settings.osd_duration_ms.label: Alert duration (ms)
settings.osd_duration_ms.description: How long the notification or now-playing OSD stays visible after a track change.
settings.lyrics_osd_enabled.label: Enable lyrics HUD
settings.lyrics_osd_enabled.description: Bar widget click toggles sticky lyrics. Off = click does nothing.
settings.lyrics_osd_position.label: Lyrics HUD position
settings.lyrics_osd_position.description: Where the overlay sits on screen. Reopen the HUD after changing.
settings.lyrics_osd_show_next.label: Show next line
settings.lyrics_osd_show_next.descriptio: Dim preview of the upcoming lyric under the current line.
settings.lyrics_osd_animate_cues.label: Animate cue dots
settings.lyrics_osd_animate_cues.descrip: Pulse three cue dots through intros, interludes, and song mixes. Off = static dots.
settings.lyrics_osd_karaoke.label: Word sing-along highlight
settings.lyrics_osd_karaoke.description: Highlight the currently sung word when Apple syllable timings exist. Line-only lyrics light the whole active line to match Cider.
settings.lyrics_osd_glow.label: Lyric glass
settings.lyrics_osd_glow.description: Small frosted blur behind overlay glyphs so they stay readable on wallpaper. Not a color glow.
settings.lyrics_karaoke_style.label: Karaoke colors
settings.lyrics_karaoke_style.descriptio: Theme follows the live Noctalia palette (on_surface + primary). Custom uses the hex fields below.
settings.lyrics_karaoke_sung.label: Sung word color
settings.lyrics_karaoke_sung.description: Hex for already-sung words when Karaoke colors is Custom. Empty keeps the theme color. Example: #f2f3f3
settings.lyrics_karaoke_active.label: Active word color
settings.lyrics_karaoke_active.descripti: Hex for the word currently being sung when Custom. Empty keeps Noctalia primary. Example: #83c2c8
settings.lyrics_karaoke_upcoming.label: Upcoming word color
settings.lyrics_karaoke_upcoming.descrip: Hex for not-yet-sung words in the current line when Custom. Empty uses sung color at lower opacity.
settings.lyrics_osd_show_idle.label: Show idle placeholder
settings.lyrics_osd_show_idle.descriptio: When the HUD is open with no lyrics yet, show a muted music/idle message instead of a blank overlay.
settings.show_cover.label: Show cover
settings.show_cover.description: Show the current Cider artwork on the bar chip when a local cover file is available.
settings.cover_size.label: Cover size
settings.cover_size.description: Artwork edge length on the bar chip, in logical pixels (12–32).
